ITEM.PTXT: Cylinders No. 1 and No. 4, and cylinders No. 2 and No. 3, are in the same phase as each other and are 180° opposite in phase, so if the piston motion were perfect simple harmonic motion , the reciprocating inertia forces would cancel each other out. In an actual engine, due to the principle of the crank-piston mechanism, the piston speed is greatest on the top dead center side of the middle of the stroke even when the crankshaft rotation speed is constant, so higher-order (distortion) components are generated. These higher-order components occur 2 times per 1 crankshaft revolution, particularly in in-line 4-cylinder engines, and since they do not cancel but overlap each other, they cause increased vibration and noise. This component is the 2-order inertia force.
